energy_chunking: none; all target and grid energies share one forward per pass
dropout_mask_coupling: ordinary elementwise network dropout in one forward; no forced mask sharing across query energies
extension_trigger: either model has independent-stream 200-pass RMSE above 0.25 percentage points in either continuum grid, or relative normalized-curvature difference above 10 percent
dropout_disabled_interpretation: separate deterministic network prediction, not the infinite-MC limit
coverage_interpretation: 68-percent central dropout-draw bin interval checked against finite empirical bin acceptance; a model-consistency diagnostic, not calibrated confidence coverage
